boundary: Source classification, not 45 successful UI tests; no original inventory/status or source was modified.

rows.label: Original ReaderApp state/navigation
rows.rationale: Original ReaderApp is already mounted by native.sefariaEmbedded; that root does not select an exact text, version, segment, menu or any of the other 44 rows.

rows.label: RN texts/library navigation
rows.rationale: Call original openNav; require original root navigation state and visible TextsPage header. Original query/filter clearing remains. Arbitrary category paths are separate, unavailable targets.

rows.label: RN category/text list
rows.rationale: Needs a finite/backend-qualified original category/work identity, exact category state, original list row and real visibility; the Library root does not cover it.

rows.label: RN Reader controls
rows.rationale: The controls container is not one semantic action. Individual original controls require a finite operation and exact reader/context witness; arbitrary semanticControl/selector execution is unavailable.

rows.label: RN reading column
rows.rationale: Exact reading-column reveal needs original backend-qualified text/version identity and loaded original column/position; no root-only receipt can attest it.

rows.label: RN exact text segment selection
rows.rationale: Exact segment reveal/selection requires original segment identity, original selection state and visible selected segment, with no private text in public URLs.

rows.label: RN text TOC and versions
rows.rationale: Original text TOC requires the current original work/structure/node/version and original visible row; openTextToc alone is insufficient for exact-node acceptance.

rows.label: RN connections/commentary panel
rows.rationale: Original related-content panel requires the exact retained segment and original connection mode/source; revealing the root ReaderApp is insufficient.

rows.label: RN connections filters/header
rows.rationale: A fixed relationship/filter control can be meaningful, but must retain original segment/filter state and exact visible control. No arbitrary author/private filter mutation is exposed.

rows.label: RN linked-source content
rows.rationale: Pinned LinkContent.js is a seven-line data constructor (en, he, sectionRef), not a mounted control. Original visible connections have their own rows and contracts.

rows.label: RN version selection
rows.rationale: Original version selection/reveal requires exact original work/version identity and original visible version state; it cannot be represented by a generic page receipt.

rows.label: RN available translations
rows.rationale: Original translations UI needs exact original work/version/language context and visible original control. Automatic preference changes are outside navigation.

rows.label: RN dictionary/lexicon
rows.rationale: Original dictionary/lexicon reveal needs the actual selected word and original source/lookup identity; no arbitrary private word/query is inserted into a public route.

rows.label: RN text display options
rows.rationale: Opening/focusing the original display panel can be meaningful. Changing language/font/layout values is a separate user action; current finite roots do not dismiss or operate it.

rows.label: RN global search page
rows.rationale: Original RN SearchPage is the results/search owner, not a substitute for the separate Maktabah search engine. Exact original query/session state and original input/result witnesses are required.

rows.label: RN search result page
rows.rationale: Requires original submitted query/generation and exact loaded result identity/row, with no query text in public navigation tokens and no root-only success.

rows.label: RN search filter selection
rows.rationale: Original filter panel reveal is meaningful only with the exact original search context and original panel control. This slice does not apply filter values.

rows.label: RN search autocomplete
rows.rationale: Original autocomplete input can be a finite focus target after its real input/first-responder/source contract is implemented. openAutocomplete by itself does not prove field focus.

rows.label: RN history/saved page
rows.rationale: HistorySavedPage owns a local saved/history mode and synchronizes profile on mount. ReaderApp menu history does not select a private record or exact local mode; its saved render case is commented out. No invented saved-menu route or automatic private record selection.

rows.label: RN Settings page
rows.rationale: Original SettingsPage reveal requires exact original owner/control and source proof. Its syncProfile effect and original account/settings behavior remain; the four public roots do not mount this page.

rows.label: RN account menu
rows.rationale: Opening an original account menu may be meaningful, but account identity/session and privacy must be retained. It does not authorize login/logout, sync mutations, deletion or external web actions.

rows.label: RN auth screen
rows.rationale: Revealing an original sign-in form is distinct from submitting credentials. No original field/entity/keyboard contract is implemented in this slice; no automated authentication action.

rows.label: RN password reset screen
rows.rationale: Revealing the original reset form is distinct from sending a reset request. No submit/account action or private address is accepted by these routes.

rows.label: RN topics/category detail
rows.rationale: Call original openTopicToc(true); require navigationTopic null and original visible TopicCategory root header. LoadingView is not completion. Exact topic detail remains unavailable.

rows.label: RN topic list
rows.rationale: The original list of topics related to a retained source requires exact topic/source identity and actual visible item; the root Explore by Topic screen does not cover it.

rows.label: RN learning schedules
rows.rationale: Call original openMenu learning schedules; require exact menu and original page header plus unique description, not the same title in Library. Calendar data completeness is separate.

rows.label: RN source-sheet metadata
rows.rationale: Original SheetMeta requires a retained real sheet identity and original visible metadata. A public unqualified numeric ID or arbitrary content mutation is not accepted.

rows.label: RN About page
rows.rationale: Pinned AboutBox is current-text information in ConnectionsPanel about mode, not the app About page. Requires exact current text and original panel; the account app-about link is external web navigation.

rows.label: RN footer tab selection
rows.rationale: Original footer container is not a generic public tab executor. setFooterTab may restore prior tab state, so finite roots call the original specific methods instead of claiming footer selection proves a root.

rows.label: Upstream RN link parser
rows.rationale: Original DeepLinkRouter is routing infrastructure, not a visible target. It accepts more than the strict public contract, so new routes do not forward arbitrary URLs/JS/queries to it.

rows.label: RN error boundary fallback
rows.rationale: ErrorBoundaryFallbackComponent is an actual failure surface. It is not intentionally opened or counted as successful semantic navigation.

rows.label: RN browser content view
rows.rationale: Only an explicitly reviewed safe original document/link and its visible original web owner could be meaningful. Arbitrary URLs, private tokens, embedded commands and browser fallback are not accepted.

rows.label: RN interface language subsection
rows.rationale: Original language control may be revealed/focused with its exact owner. Navigation alone never changes the original interface language or bypasses user choice.

rows.label: RN text language subsection
rows.rationale: Original text-language control reveal is separate from changing preference; requires actual settings row and original state.

rows.label: RN offline network preference
rows.rationale: Original network/offline preference row can be a guide target, but value changes require a separate explicit action; no network policy mutation is exposed.

rows.label: RN offline access/install/update/delete review
rows.rationale: Original offline-library controls need their exact original UI and installed-resource state. Navigation does not install, update, download or delete resources.

rows.label: Excluded RN debug destructive control
rows.rationale: Original hidden destructive debug controls are excluded from public routes, intents and automated guide actions; no artificial completion or relaxed gate.

rows.label: RN email-frequency setting
rows.rationale: Original account-linked email preference may be a user-directed guide focus only; no public GET or automatic preference/profile write.

rows.label: RN reading-history setting
rows.rationale: Original history privacy preference may be a user-directed guide focus only; no automatic history/consent mutation or private payload in public routes.

rows.label: RN preferred custom setting
rows.rationale: Original preferred-custom row may be revealed with its original owner. No automatic profile/preference write is authorized by navigation.

rows.label: RN grogger preference
rows.rationale: Original grogger preference control remains user-operated. Exact reveal/focus is unavailable until its original-row contract exists.

rows.label: RN logout flow
rows.rationale: Direct logout is a state-changing account action, explicitly excluded by the original inventory; no public navigation side effect.

rows.label: RN account deletion flow
rows.rationale: Account deletion is explicitly excluded by the original inventory; no automatic selection/confirmation or invocation.

rows.label: RN dedication information page
rows.rationale: Original Dedication is an informational page. Finite native reveal uses original openMenu dedication and actual title; preserve original guide/Hanlin suitability and do not advertise a direct public action without reviewed reclassification.

rows.label: RN interrupting-message modal
rows.rationale: InterruptingMessage is an original runtime notice/modal, not an automatic action or destination. An open notice blocks this slice; it is never dismissed automatically.
